settings.notes: Fill `url` for each list with the canonical page for THAT specific, pinned list. The scraper only updates the list whose identity matches below (same prestige/list year over year) — a publication's other, lesser lists are ignored.

awards.note: Star/winner changes update the mich/bib/jba list memberships. Fill per-city award pages below; Michelin is JS-rendered (parser=browser).

closures_relocations.note: Eater closings/openings feed per city. Closures mark cl=true (kept, struck-through); relocations update hood + lat/lng.

new_lists.note: When a watched publication posts a NEW prestigious city list, it is flagged for your approval (never auto-added) to keep prestige discipline.
